thread:
sam: @channel Seeing control-plane auth failures in na-east3 since ~12:04 UTC. Console 502s for several tenants and API routing returns 503s. Logs show token validation errors and lease renew failures: "lease expired for leader" and "kv read timeout". Anyone else?

tara: getting the same alerts. Incident page popped. Pinged oncall infra. :eyes:

miguel: pulling logs now. etcd in na-east3 shows intermittent network timeouts to backing storage. Lots of leader elections. stack snippet: 
```
etcd: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
leader: lost lease, attempting campaign
```

anjali: deploy-bot shows config rollout rl-8432 paused (authz failures). Canary deploys failing because auth checks return 500s.

lisa: console frontend 502s are from auth-proxy returning 401 -> frontend treats as bad gateway. curl to auth-proxy times out.

kevin: capacity note: na-west2 has spare GPU pools (~60% free). We can traffic-shift compute but control-plane state (routes, tokens) is region-bound. We'll need config replay or routing override. Cost will spike but better than outage.

sam: agree. Prioritize routing for non-interactive endpoints first (embeddings, batch jobs). Keep chat/chat-streaming in place until we confirm token consistency. @miguel can you stage the route override?

miguel: starting staged override now. Command I used: 
```
routemgr override --src na-east3 --dst na-west2 --match "/v1/embeddings/*" --mode staged --batch-size 10
```
Applied to 10% users for bg-inference route. Monitoring metrics.

infra-bot: Alert: na-east3 control-plane etcd leader flapping detected (10+ leader changes in 5m). Automated leader transfer attempted.

anjali: auth issuer tokens are stored in region KV; renewing tokens across regions might fail if KV is partitioned. We should enable token fallback to global-cache (runbook section 4). Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/internal/controlplane-failover

sam: good call. @lisa can you flip auth-proxy to use token-cache fallback? It's config flag "AUTH_TOKEN_FALLBACK=global". Remember to keep the rollout paused for other config changes.

lisa: flipping now for auth-proxy in na-east3. Doing one pod at a time: 
```
kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/auth-proxy AUTH_TOKEN_FALLBACK=global
```
Rolling restart in progress.

deploy-bot: Config rollout rl-8432 remains paused due to authz check failures. Manual overrides applied to auth-proxy to enable fallback.

miguel: after fallback, auth-proxy responses improved for a subset of requests. 401s reduced ~70%. Still seeing intermittent 5xx from route manager when fetching service catalog.

kevin: while we heal etcd, we should schedule a temporary traffic-shift for interactive customers to na-west2. I'll open a cost war room if needed. We need approval to double run rates during the shift.

sam: approve temporary shift for P0 tenants. Keep finance in loop. @kevin open ticket and tag @finance.

kevin: opened FIN-3421 and tagged finance. Also scheduling burst GPUS in na-west2: requesting +8 p100 nodes. Provisioner shows a 7m boot time.

miguel: provisioning started. prov logs: 
```
provisioner: request nodes=8 region=na-west2 status=queued
provisioner: booting image redwood-runtime:v6
```

anjali: note: do not resume full rollout until KV consistency checks pass. We'll run kv-compare job (runbook step 6).

sam: agreed. Next steps checklist:
- keep staged overrides for background routes
- enable global token fallback (done)
- provision na-west2 GPUs (in progress)
- run kv-compare after leader stabilizes
- prepare postmortem owner (assign after incident)

lisa: rolling restart finished for auth-proxy, healthchecks green for auth endpoints where fallback allowed. Console load improved for some tenants. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Notice: etcd leader stabilized at 12:11 UTC, leader=etcd-3, election_count=0 in last 2m.

miguel: running kv-compare now between na-east3 and global-cache. Small key drift detected in session-lease entries (~0.03%). Starting reconciliation job.

sam: nice. Once reconciliation completes, we'll start re-pointing interactive routes slowly (5% steps) and watch latency/errors.

kevin: GPUs provisioned and capacity ready in na-west2. Routing override can be expanded on my mark.

miguel: expanding override to 40% for embeddings and 10% for low-latency chat. Command: 
```
routemgr override --expand --id override-391 --pct-embeddings 40 --pct-chat 10
```

anjali: monitoring authz regression tests. No new failures after fallback and reconciliation started.

sam: good. Post-incident actions: assign postmortem owner, note runbook gaps (token fallback isn't fully automated), consider cross-region KV replication improvements.

lisa: volunteer to own postmortem draft. Will include timeline, mitigations, cost delta for shifting, and runbook updates.

sam: thanks. Assigning owner: lisa. Set target doc by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> partial recovery. Please move to incident review when ready.

kevin: one more item: estimate for cost delta during shift: projected +$9.2k for 6h burst. I'll send breakdown.

sam: thanks everyone. Good ops. We'll keep the incident channel open until full rollout resumes.
